sec-head.h2: When generative AI is NOT the right choice

p: Generative AI for marketing content excels at scaling drafts, personalization, and rapid iteration. It must never be used for final legal disclaimers, regulated financial advice, or highly sensitive crisis communications without explicit human review and sign-off. Any automated system must enforce a human-in-the-loop QA gate for brand-critical assets.

faq-item.faq-q: How do you maintain brand voice across channels with generative AI?
faq-item.faq-a: We fine-tune base models on your existing brand guidelines and content archives, then apply deterministic style rules per channel. A human-in-the-loop QA gate reviews every output for tone consistency before publication.

faq-item.faq-q: Can the system integrate with existing marketing platforms like HubSpot or Salesforce?
faq-item.faq-a: Yes. We connect via APIs to your CMS, email service provider, and social scheduling tools. The pipeline can auto-populate drafts, suggest subject lines, and flag compliance issues while respecting your existing workflows.

faq-item.faq-q: How does the system prevent factual hallucinations in marketing copy?
faq-item.faq-a: The system enforces source grounding: all claims about products, features, or pricing are pulled from a curated knowledge base. When confidence is low, the content is routed to a human reviewer for fact-checking before any distribution.

faq-item.faq-q: Do I need a content automation agency or can an independent engineer build this?
faq-item.faq-a: Working directly with a specialized independent engineer gives you direct accountability, faster iteration, and no bureaucratic overhead. You get hands-on tuning of brand voice and QA loops without paying for agency account management layers.

faq-item.faq-q: How much does a generative AI marketing system cost to build?
faq-item.faq-a: A scoped proof-of-concept for a single channel starts at $2,500 to $6,000. A full production system with multi-channel support, brand voice fine-tuning, and human-in-loop QA typically ranges from $12,000 to $45,000.
